items.raw_excerpt: The species were hit hard by chytrid fungus in the 80s and 90s, but new research suggests two frogs have recovered to now expand to new territories, while one is still constrained.
items.summary_en: Scientists used environmental DNA to study three frog species in Australia's Wet Tropics. Two species, badly hit by a fungus in the 1980s and 1990s, are now recovering and moving into new areas. The third species is still constrained.
items.summary_ko: 연구자들은 환경 DNA로 호주 열대 우림의 개구리 세 종을 살펴봤습니다. 1980~90년대에 곰팡이병으로 큰 타격을 입은 두 종은 회복해 새로운 지역으로 퍼져나가고 있습니다. 나머지 한 종은 아직 퍼져나가지 못하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Two frog species are bouncing back from a deadly fungus in Australia
items.title_ko: 호주 개구리 두 종, 곰팡이병에서 회복하고 있어요
items.title_original: Environmental DNA shows some frog species bouncing back from fungus

items.raw_excerpt: Als DJ, Produzentin und Labelgründerin gehört BLOND:ISH zu den markanten Stimmen der internationalen House-Szene. Neben ihrer musikalischen Arbeit engagiert sie sich für Nachhaltigkeit in der Club- und Festivalkultur. Mit ihrer Initiative Bye Bye Plastic kämpft sie gegen Plastikmüll auf Veranstaltungen und verbindet elektronische Musik mit gesellschaftlichem Engagement.
items.summary_en: Blond:ish is a well-known voice in the international house music scene as a DJ, producer and label founder. She works for sustainability in club and festival culture. Through her initiative Bye Bye Plastic, she fights plastic waste at events and connects electronic music with social engagement.
items.summary_ko: 블론디쉬는 디제이이자 프로듀서, 레이블 창립자로 국제 하우스 뮤직 장면에서 주목받는 목소리다. 그녀는 클럽과 축제 문화의 지속 가능성을 위해 힘쓰고 있다. 자신의 이니셔티브 바이 바이 플라스틱을 통해 행사장의 플라스틱 쓰레기와 싸우며 전자 음악과 사회적 참여를 잇고 있다.
items.title_en: Blond:ish, a house music DJ, pushes for plastic-free festivals

items.raw_excerpt: La sanrafaelina Noelia Guajardo viajará a Laborde, Córdoba, para participar de la 56ª edición del Festival Nacional del Malambo, el cual apunta mucho a la danza tradicional en pareja y en conjunto. Sobre ello brindó algunos detalles a través de FM Vos (94.5) y de Diario San Rafael, y solicitó ayuda económica a la comunidad. […]
items.summary_en: Noelia Guajardo, a dancer from San Rafael, will travel to Laborde in Cordoba for the 56th National Malambo Festival. The festival focuses on traditional couple and group dance. She asked the community for economic help to cover her trip.

items.raw_excerpt: The outlying Kinmen County has suspended shipments of pork and processed pork products to Taiwan proper and other offshore islands through Aug. 31 after African swine fever (ASF) was detected in the carcass of a pig that drifted ashore.
items.summary_en: African swine fever was found in a dead pig that washed ashore in Kinmen. The county stopped shipping pork and processed pork products to the main island of Taiwan and other offshore islands until August 31.
